prompt: Write docs/notes.md: a short Markdown bulleted list naming the three Python files in this repo and the bug each one has.

memories.content:
Decision: use an asterisk as the Markdown list marker
Lists in Markdown can be indicated by `*` (asterisk) or `-` (hyphen). Chosen option: "Use an asterisk", because an asterisk does not have a meaning of "good" or "bad", whereas a hyphen `-` could be read as indicator of something negative (in contrast to `+`, which could be more be read as "good").
